title: School & Review Center Reviewer Sources
note: These uploaded reviewer collections are treated as legacy/reference material. The app should not blindly copy old answers or outdated policy facts. New practice questions should be rewritten into original board-style items, checked against the current PRC TOS and current official references, deduplicated, and given explanations.

collections.name: Green Empire LEAR Reviewer
collections.description: Lecture Manual and Review Questions collection covering Crop Science, Soil Science, Animal Science, Crop Protection, Agricultural Economics & Marketing, and Agricultural Extension & Communication.
collections.usePolicy: Use concepts and recurring reviewer themes to guide original high-yield questions; verify technical details against current TOS and official references.

collections.name: VSU Q&A Reviewer
collections.description: Question-and-answer reviewer collection organized by the six Agriculturists Licensure Examination subject areas.
collections.usePolicy: Use as a legacy question-pattern and concept-coverage reference; rewrite and verify before adding to the live bank.

collections.name: UPLB College of Agriculture PRC Licensure Reviewer
collections.description: University of the Philippines Los Baños College of Agriculture review-question collection, Revised Version 2006.
collections.usePolicy: Use for enduring core concepts and classic board-review coverage. Treat time-sensitive facts, policies, statistics, names, and recommendations as historical until re-verified.

collections.name: DOSCST Review Collection
collections.coverage: All six ALE subjects; multiple Q&A sets
collections.description: Multi-set licensure review collection with numerous subject-specific question-and-answer sets across the six ALE areas.
collections.usePolicy: Use recurring concepts and question patterns as input for original questions; correct obsolete terminology or outdated factual claims before use.

integrationRules: Current PRC TOS has priority over old reviewer emphasis.
Do not assume an old answer key is correct without verification.
Rewrite source-inspired items rather than mechanically duplicating wording.
Prefer situational, analytical, diagnostic, calculation, and best-action questions when the TOS emphasizes application.
Preserve source attribution at collection level for study transparency.
Do not treat any legacy reviewer item as a leaked or guaranteed future PRC question.
